source.citation: Energy and Geoscience Institute, University of Utah. Utah FORGE: Well 16A(78)-32 Drilling Data (directional survey, COMPASS Design Report dated 19-Dec-20). DOE Geothermal Data Repository, submission 1283. Coordinates read from a copy at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-chambers/forgery/main/src/forgery/data/well_data/16A_survey.csv on 2026-09-26, not from the publication itself; location approximate until checked against it. The copy carries the full report header (client, field, well, survey count, reference point, depth references, calculation method). Datum taken from the 16B(78)-32 listing for the same pad (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-chambers/forgery/main/src/forgery/data/well_data/16B_survey.csv, header "GEODIC DATUM: NAD83 Utah - HARN"); the 16A report prints UTM zone 12N US-survey-foot coordinates without naming it. The reference point converts to the same wellhead latitude/longitude as two other public copies of the 16A(78)-32 wellhead: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mehulfollytobevice/well/main/data/seed/wells.csv (lat 38.504013, lon -112.896407, attributed there to utahforge.com and OpenEI) and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cjhopp/scripts/master/python/experiment/FORGE_composite_3D.py (ref_lat 38.50402147, ref_lon -112.8963897, UTM 334641.1891 E 4263443.693 N).

Energy and Geoscience Institute, University of Utah. Utah FORGE: Well 16B(78)-32 Drilling Data (well survey, "16B(78)-32 Final Surveys" listing dated 6/26/2023). DOE Geothermal Data Repository, submission 1516, DOI 10.15121/1998591. Coordinates read from a copy at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-chambers/forgery/main/src/forgery/data/well_data/16B_survey.csv on 2026-09-26, not from the publication itself; location approximate until checked against it. The copy carries the listing header (map system, datum, zone, north reference, wellhead easting/northing, KB and GL elevations, calculation method). In the copy the last decimal digit of MD had spilled into the INC column for the deepest rows; repaired as described in the CSV header and checked against the listing's own NORTHING, EASTING and SSTVD columns.

Primary publication not located; coordinates read from a copy at https://github.com/d-chambers/forgery/tree/main/src/forgery/data/Utah_FORGE_regional_wells on 2026-09-26; location approximate.
